exposure: Prelabour fetal heart rate short-term variability (STV)
prelabour fetal heart rate short-term variability (STV)
outcome: Emergency delivery due to pathological CTG during labour
cohort: 400 pregnant women at term gestation in latent phase of labour or before labour induction
finding: Prelabour fetal heart rate short-term variability (STV) was weakly positively associated with umbilical cord arterial pH but not predictive of emergency delivery due to pathological CTG during labour.
